title: Not all businesses are equally easy to get results for.. That sounds ...
description: Not all businesses are equally easy to get results for.. That sounds obvious, but it wasn't obvious when I started! 😆
transcript: What was something about building an agency you thought would be easy but was actually quite difficult? I thought it would be easier to get results for clients than it was when I started building agency. Like my first client, if you can call her a client, was my mum's interior design business. And it's actually really easy to get results in an industry like that because the customers are worth, I think our average customers worth about 75 k. You could generate leads for like two, 300 a pop and it was still really profitable. Whereas then you start speaking to a business and they're like, right, well our customers are worth $45. We need to generate leads for $7 cause we convert one in three. And you're like, oh, right, that's way harder.
